name: Standing Street Vendor Advisory Committee Regular Agenda 10-30-2023
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  STANDING STREET VENDOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Monday, October 30, 2023 - 4:30 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall East
  City Council Chambers
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Minutes of September 12, 2023

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Members of the public may comment provided such comments are within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee. Speakers will be given 2 minutes to speak per
  person. The Committee may not deliberate or act upon matters not appearing on
  the agenda but may direct staff to place the matter on a future Committee agenda.

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  6.1  Receive staff presentation and provide recommendation on proposed mobile
  food vendor (food trucks) draft ordinance for City Council consideration.

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted on October 26, 2023 at 4:20 p.m.
